metadata.title: Bible Map — Genesis places
metadata.scope: Every mappable place record with a Genesis reference in the source dataset
metadata.source: Adapted from OpenBible.info Bible Geocoding Data (CC BY 4.0)
metadata.method: Each ancient place is shown at the highest-scoring modern association with coordinates. Lower-confidence and competing identifications are marked uncertain.

properties.description: One of several candidate regions in current data; this boundary is a visual guide, not a claim of an exact ancient location.
A second, competing candidate region shown to preserve the uncertainty in the underlying data.
